title: Impact of Asp/Glu-ADP-ribosylation on protein-protein interaction and protein function.
authors: Pei, Jimin; Zhang, Jing; Wang, Xu-Dong; Kim, Chiho; Yu, Yonghao; Cong, Qian
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold预测PAR化蛋白的蛋白-蛋白互作界面，虽涉及转录相关复合物，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: PARylation plays critical role in regulating multiple cellular processes such as DNA damage response and repair, transcription, RNA processing, and stress response. More than 300 human proteins have been found to be modified by PARylation on acidic residues, that is, Asp (D) and Glu (E). We used the deep-learning tool AlphaFold to predict protein-protein interactions (PPIs) and their interfaces for these proteins based on coevolution signals from joint multiple sequence alignments (MSAs). AlphaFold predicted 260 confident PPIs involving PARylated proteins, and about one quarter of these PPIs have D/E-PARylation sites in their predicted PPI interfaces. AlphaFold predictions offer novel insights into the mechanisms of PARylation regulations by providing structural details of the PPI interfaces. D/E-PARylation sites have a preference to occur in coil regions and disordered regions, and PPI interfaces containing D/E-PARylation sites tend to occur between short linear sequence motifs in disordered regions and globular domains. The hub protein PCNA is predicted to interact with more than 20 proteins via the common PIP box motif and the structurally variable flanking regions. D/E-PARylation sites were found in the interfaces of key components of the RNA transcription and export complex, the SF3a spliceosome complex, and H/ACA and C/D small nucleolar ribonucleoprotein complexes, suggesting that systematic PARylation have a profound effect in regulating multiple RNA-related processes such as RNA nuclear export, splicing, and modification. Finally, PARylation of SUMO2 could modulate its interaction with CHAF1A, thereby representing a potential mechanism for the cross-talk between PARylation and SUMOylation in regulation of chromatin remodeling.
abstract_zh: PARylation在调控多种细胞过程中发挥关键作用，例如DNA损伤应答与修复、转录、RNA加工以及应激反应。已发现超过300种人类蛋白在酸性残基，即天冬氨酸（Asp, D）和谷氨酸（Glu, E）上被PARylation修饰。我们使用深度学习工具AlphaFold，基于联合多序列比对（MSAs）的共进化信号，预测这些蛋白之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）及其界面。AlphaFold预测了涉及PARylated蛋白的260个高置信度PPIs，其中约四分之一的PPIs在其预测的PPI界面中包含D/E-PARylation位点。AlphaFold预测通过提供PPI界面的结构细节，为PARylation调控机制提供了新见解。D/E-PARylation位点倾向于出现在卷曲区域和无序区域，而含有D/E-PARylation位点的PPI界面倾向于发生在无序区域中的短线性序列基序与球状结构域之间。枢纽蛋白PCNA被预测通过常见的PIP box基序和结构可变的侧翼区域与超过20种蛋白相互作用。在RNA转录和输出复合物、SF3a剪接体复合物以及H/ACA和C/D小核仁核糖核蛋白复合物的界面中发现了D/E-PARylation位点，这表明系统性PARylation在调控多种RNA相关过程（如RNA核输出、剪接和修饰）中具有深远影响。最后，SUMO2的PARylation可能调节其与CHAF1A的相互作用，从而代表PARylation与SUMOylation在调控染色质重塑中交叉对话的潜在机制。
